question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is __Strengthen__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The word strengthen is correctly spelt.
 
• The word strengthen means to make or become stronger.

*Example *: This shampoo strengthen weak hair.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The correct spelling or word Eqiupment will be Equipment

*Example *: These equipment's are required for plant tissue culture.

The correct spelling for word Instrumentle will be Instrumental.

*Example *: Tonight there is a music instrumental.

The correct spelling for word Reverel will be Reversal.

*Example *: He reversed the position of the two stamps
